{{UALAN_Navbox}} [[Image:Logo-ualan2.gif|right|UALAN Logo]] In the mid-00s, guys from Ukrain - {{Player|Hook|flag=ua}}, {{Player|Fireman|flag=ua}}, {{Player|Skar|flag=ua}}, {{Player|RED|flag=ua}}, {{Player|XAPOH|flag=ua}} organized five cool lanparties in Kharkov. Visiting players were accommodated at the hosts and in hotels, a awesome entertainment program was present every evening after the games.
